what: Buyer reports two payments taken by Lemon Squeezy without their knowledge; has never heard of Lemon Squeezy or how they gained access to the account; none of the buyer's email addresses appear in Lemon Squeezy records; states there is no phone number to contact; demands money back.
verbatim_snippet: "They have taken two payments, but I have never heard of them or how they gained access to my account. When trying to figure out which email is attached, I found that none of my emails are on their records to recover the account, if I have one. There is no number to contact to speak to someone to stop this. I want my money back."
notes: Reviewer: Nkechi-Vivien Commettant. Buyer does not recognize Lemon Squeezy as a company they purchased from — consistent with merchant-of-record model where "Lemon Squeezy" appears on bank statements rather than the actual product seller's name.
